Your Favorite Pokemon Exposes Your Red Flags — Part 2

thread // Jun 10, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Watch on YouTube

I'm convinced every Pokémon fanbase has one shared red flag.

Some are loyal to a fault. Some think being mysterious is a personality. Some turn every minor inconvenience into a boss fight.

Grookey and Tyrunt came straight from the comments on Part 1, so Part 2 had to happen.

  • Grookey fans turn every serious moment into a joke.
  • Tyrunt fans are tough until one tiny inconvenience ruins their whole day.
  • Lucario fans turn every conversation into a training arc.
  • Eevee fans aren't indecisive. They're one group chat away from unlocking a new personality.

Grookey: everything's a joke

Grookey is the playful little Grass-type chimp from Sword and Shield, always drumming on something with its stick. Grookey fans bring that same energy to every situation. Serious conversation? Here comes a bit.

Tyrunt: boss fight over nothing

Tyrunt is a baby T. rex brought back from a fossil, and its Pokédex entries say it throws tantrums when it doesn't get its way. Tyrunt fans are tough, right up until one tiny inconvenience turns into a whole boss fight.

Lucario: every conversation is a training arc

Lucario reads aura, lives by discipline and carries itself like the main character of a martial arts movie. Lucario fans can't just talk. Every conversation turns into a lesson, a grind or a life-improvement speech.

Eevee: one group chat away

Eevee has eight different evolutions depending on what happens to it. Eevee fans aren't indecisive. They're just one group chat away from unlocking a brand-new personality.

Quick answers

What is Tyrunt? A Rock- and Dragon-type fossil Pokémon that looks like a baby T. rex. It evolves into Tyrantrum.

How many evolutions does Eevee have? Eight: Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon and Sylveon.

What game is Grookey from? Pokémon Sword and Shield, where it's one of the three starter Pokémon.

What is Lucario known for? Sensing and using aura, and its disciplined, fighter-like personality.

Your turn

Which Pokémon fanbase is in the most denial about its red flags? Drop a Pokémon, and I'll expose the fanbase in Part 3. 📺
